instruction: Cinematic medium shot inside a boxing ring. The East Asian woman in a white ribbed sports bra (R2) stands on the left in profile, extending her left arm. Facing her on the right, the Caucasian woman in a black and orange sports top (R1) uses both hands to wrap a black athletic wrap around the East Asian woman's (R2) wrist. The background shows red and black ring ropes and hanging punching bags under bright overhead gym lights.
elements: R1 wraps a black athletic wrap around R2's wrist
R2 extends her left arm to be wrapped by R1
R1 uses both hands while applying the wrist wrap to R2
black athletic wrap on R2's wrist
boxing ring with red and black ropes
hanging punching bags in the gym background
